summary: Evaluate the source's Taylor, asymptotic or integral R-function branch and 2x2 companion matrix.

identity.relation: dimensionless x and lambda to selected R branch and companion matrix
identity.direction: dimensionless x and lambda to selected R branch and companion matrix
identity.definition: Ordered RYLA selector uses three Taylor tests, an asymptotic test, then a 16-point Gauss-Legendre integral fallback; RC[0,1]=d(lambda R)/d lambda.
identity.model: Ronnmark rational response for magnetized Maxwellian dispersion
identity.coordinates: dimensionless complex x and lambda plane
identity.boundary: branch comparisons and arithmetic follow source real/complex behavior; scalar finite inputs only
assumptions: Input units and normalization follow the declared ports; no physical parameters are inferred.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: Ronnmark argument Y, equal to (omega-kz*vt*czj)/wcs in the frozen source. Real or complex scalar. Units: dimensionless (normalized frequency). Validity constraint: must be finite (no `NaN`/`inf`); real inputs use real double-precision arithmetic and complex inputs use complex double-precision arithmetic (their rounding differs; see the Behavior and boundaries section); this operator accepts scalars only, so array inputs must be looped elementwise by the caller.
inputs.constraints: Must be finite (no `NaN`/`inf`); real inputs use real double-precision arithmetic and complex inputs use complex double-precision arithmetic (their rounding differs; see the Behavior and boundaries section); this operator accepts scalars only, so array inputs must be looped elementwise by the caller.

inputs.name: lambda_
inputs.description: AL=lambda=(k_perp*rho_c)^2, the Ronnmark expansion parameter (frozen source). Shape/axis order: scalar (real or complex; with a nonzero imaginary part on the complex kx plane). Units: dimensionless. Validity constraint: must be finite; nonnegative real for real kx and complex for complex kx; lambda=0 makes RINT's C=YR/AL and XO diverge and lies in the source's own undefined domain.
inputs.constraints: Must be finite; nonnegative real for real kx and complex for complex kx; lambda=0 makes RINT's C=YR/AL and XO diverge and lies in the source's own undefined domain.

outputs.name: R
outputs.description: R(x,lambda)=RC(1,1), the Ronnmark R-function value. Complex scalar. Units: dimensionless. Validity constraint: on the RTAY Y^2=I^2 pole (e.g. x=12, lambda=9) this branch returns `NaN`; the public selector follows the frozen source through RINT for the same parameters, so `scientific_function` still returns a finite value there.
outputs.constraints: On the RTAY Y^2=I^2 pole (e.g. x=12, lambda=9) this branch returns `NaN`; the public selector follows the frozen source through RINT for the same parameters, so `scientific_function` still returns a finite value there.

outputs.name: dR_dlambda
outputs.description: RC(1,2) column, the `dRsj` read by the frozen source. Complex scalar. Units: dimensionless. Validity constraint: computed in the same branch as `R`; the source series expansion verifies analytically that this column equals d(lambda*R)/dlambda = R + lambda*dR/dlambda, not dR/dlambda itself (in the frozen source PN_I is proportional to lambda^(I-1) while the accumulation weight is I, so RC(1,2) = R + lambda*dR/dlambda).
outputs.constraints: Computed in the same branch as `R`; the source series expansion verifies analytically that this column equals d(lambda*R)/dlambda = R + lambda*dR/dlambda, not dR/dlambda itself (in the frozen source PN_I is proportional to lambda^(I-1) while the accumulation weight is I, so RC(1,2) = R + lambda*dR/dlambda).

outputs.name: branch
outputs.description: String identifying the branch actually selected; shape/axis order: scalar string (enumeration label, no array axis), one of `'RTAY(AL<4)'`, `'RTAY(|Y|^2>75*AL)'`, `'RTAY(|Y|>40+AL/3)'`, `'RASY'`, `'RINT'`. Units: dimensionless (enumeration label). Validity constraint: one of the five strings, corresponding one-to-one to the frozen source criteria.
outputs.constraints: One of the five strings, corresponding one-to-one to the frozen source criteria.

outputs.name: RC
outputs.description: Full 2x2 complex matrix (complex128, understood in the reference runtime's column-major order). Units: dimensionless. Validity constraint: `RC[0,0]==R` and `RC[0,1]==dR_dlambda`; `RC[1,0]` and `RC[1,1]` are companion columns computed in the same branch and are unused by the frozen source.
outputs.constraints: `RC[0,0]==R` and `RC[0,1]==dR_dlambda`; `RC[1,0]` and `RC[1,1]` are companion columns computed in the same branch and are unused by the frozen source.

preconditions: branch comparisons and arithmetic follow source real/complex behavior; scalar finite inputs only
